critical_findings.v17b_normalization_174k: v17b cross-lingual legal_area normalization generalizes to 174k corpus: 213 raw unique labels -> 163 normalized (23.5% reduction), 94.1% of labels changed, avg decisions per label increases from 428 to 560. 42 cross-lingual mappings active in corpus. Umbrella/singleton labels (124) pass through unchanged. This confirms the v16 'data granularity' attribution was partially a label normalization artifact, consistent with 1200-scale finding (108->55, 49% reduction).
critical_findings.citation_heritage_174k_ready: Full 174k citation graph constructed from cited_decisions field using resolved citation map. 91,183 decisions (52.4%) have cited_decisions field. 818,054 total citation strings, 183,616 resolved (22.4%), 7,799 resolving to corpus decisions. 5,031 source decisions with outgoing citations. 137,314 positive pairs (direct + shared citations), 137,314 negative pairs. Benchmark infrastructure ready for 174k embeddings.

All 12 benchmarks implemented in scalable_nn.py with batched processing. Exact NN fallback for <10k, HNSW for >=10k. Distributed evaluation support via worker sharding.
critical_findings.boilerplate_resistance_negative: CONFIRMED: Boilerplate resistance negative for all representations (score ~-0.9) at 1200 scale, consistent with legal-distance v6/v10 finding that proxy measures language dominance/cross-lingual alignment failure, not procedural boilerplate.
